text: Versioned code-graph revalidation / stale-direct-edge backfill: after upgrading the same-file fail-closed extraction (100-F/FF7DE872), already-persisted wrong-target direct edges remain stale until a forced reindex because hash-skip bypasses re-extraction. Add a versioned schema/extractor-generation marker that triggers targeted re-resolution of affected calls edges on upgrade (mirror 096-F opt-in backfill task). Origin: Copilot review thread PRRT_kwDORJEduc6UUYBN on PR #291.

Deferred Python-only last-wins recall recovery: 100-F/FF7DE872 fails closed (drops the direct edge) on same-file duplicate top-level defs to guarantee no wrong-target edge. For Python, where the last def legally shadows earlier ones, a future enhancement could recover recall by minting the edge to the effective (last) definition instead of failing closed. Documented v1 non-goal in docs/architecture.md 'Same-file duplicate-name resolution (FF7DE872)'.

Remediate pre-existing cargo audit advisories: 'cargo audit' reports 10 advisories from transitive dependencies (Cargo.lock byte-identical to base 1f640e02; 0 deps added by 100-F). Not a CI-blocking step. Triage/upgrade the affected transitive deps or document accepted risk. Baseline snapshot as of PR #291.

Daemon 'engram index' cross-file singleton not persisted + CLI response hang: on a fresh git workspace, plain 'engram index' via the daemon leaves cross-file singleton calls edges (e.g. alpha->beta) staged/unresolved and the 'engram index' CLI hangs on response while the daemon completes server-side. Root cause suspected at src/cli/direct.rs:162 (use_index = full || force) routing plain index to the sync path, which skips the cross-file post-pass (reresolve_calls_edges_with_canonical_context). Pre-existing, NOT caused by 100-F (18/18 recall + cross-file tests GREEN via in-process index_workspace). Investigate index-vs-sync routing + IPC response completion. See docs/compound/workflow-issues/new-extraction-logic-needs-forced-reindex-2026-07-20.md.
